name: Aegan
bio: Aegan is an Indian actor and producer working primarily in Tamil-language television and cinema. He gained recognition for his television work in the series Kana Kaanum Kaalangal before transitioning to feature films such as Joe and Kozhipannai Chelladurai.

credits.title: Haiku
credits.overview: A charismatic young man uses poetry to navigate the complex maze of modern romance to protect his fragile relationship. Later, he must overcome deep generational divides to keep his love alive.

credits.title: Niram Marum Ulagil
credits.overview: During a train journey,  A ticket examiner narrates four tales of extreme parental sacrifice, exploring familial bonds through illness, estrangement, unexpected connections, and emotional turmoil, to a young woman

credits.title: Kozhipannai Chelladurai
credits.overview: When fate deals tragic hands to a pair of siblings, Chelladurai tries his best to ensure his sister's wellbeing amid their capricious futures.

credits.title: Joe
credits.overview: Joe, who is reeling from a heartbreak by his college sweetheart Suchitra, reluctantly marries Shruthi , who isn't ready to accept him as her husband because of the ghosts from her own past.
